description: In React 18 with createRoot, state updates inside timeouts, promises, native event handlers or any other event are batched into a single re-render, whereas before React 18 they each triggered a separate render. Code relying on synchronous re-render/DOM updates between consecutive state updates outside React event handlers may behave differently. Opt out with flushSync.

evidence.relevance: Ties the batching behavior change to release 18.

evidence.quote: To opt-out of automatic batching, you can use flushSync

conditions.statement: The application performs multiple state updates inside timeouts, promises, native event handlers or other non-React events
